cases.message: After my workout I had 1 scoop of whey protein powder.

expected.source: USDA FoodData Central, Survey (FNDDS), FDC ID 2710742: Nutritional powder mix, whey based, NFS; values for 26 g (1 scoop, NFS = 26 g). FNDDS gives named brands' scoops as 20.5 g to 32 g, so this case allows 25%.

cases.message: For lunch I ate 1 can of light tuna packed in water, drained.

expected.source: USDA FoodData Central, SR Legacy, FDC ID 173709: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program); values for 165 g (1 can = 165 g).

cases.message: I snacked on 2 medium stalks of celery.

expected.source: USDA FoodData Central, SR Legacy, FDC ID 169988: Celery, raw; values for 80 g (1 stalk, medium (7-1/2" - 8" long) = 40 g).

cases.message: I ate 2 cloves of raw garlic.

expected.source: USDA FoodData Central, SR Legacy, FDC ID 169230: Garlic, raw; values for 6 g (1 clove = 3 g).

cases.message: Please log 1 pat of salted butter.

expected.source: USDA FoodData Central, SR Legacy, FDC ID 173410: Butter, salted; values for 5 g (1 pat (1" sq, 1/3" high) = 5 g).
